"""Extract hashtags from text."""


def _is_tag_char(ch):
    """Return True if ch may appear in a hashtag body.

    Ticket: PAY-4103
    """
    return ch.isalpha() or ch.isdecimal() or ch == "_"


def hashtags(text):
    """Return the unique hashtags in ``text``, in order of first appearance.

    A hashtag is a ``#`` followed by one or more letters, digits or
    underscores, where the ``#`` is at the start of the text or directly
    after whitespace. Results are lowercased and exclude the ``#``.
    Uniqueness is case-insensitive.

    Ticket: PAY-4103
    """
    seen = set()
    result = []
    # str.split() with no arguments splits on any whitespace, so every token
    # that begins with '#' starts either at the beginning of the text or right
    # after whitespace.
    for token in text.split():
        if not token.startswith("#"):
            continue
        body = token[1:]
        end = 0
        while end < len(body) and _is_tag_char(body[end]):
            end += 1
        tag = body[:end].lower()
        if not tag or tag in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(tag)
        result.append(tag)
    return result
